correctness.rationale: The relative exact sequence for the spherical graphical arrangement identifies a free integral top relative chamber module with determinant-sign action. The ambient orientation maps to the diagonal, making the quotient lattice canonical, not an augmentation kernel. Detailed directed-bit orbit counts cover both reflection axes and all rotations for every n≥3; vertex-orbit quotient arrangements give fixed loci, and rational transfer gives quotient ranks. Independently recomputed invariant orientations, inversion signs and fixed-arrangement Euler characteristics agree for all 150 dihedral elements at n=3,...,12. No finite check substitutes for the uniform proof.

value.rationale: The classical cycle graph coloring-complex family has a canonical full dihedral automorphism group. The explicit integral quotient lattice is a more precise invariant than a rational character or wedge multiplicity; the full element-fixed PL topology distinguishes two different reflection axes by multiplicity 1 versus 2^(n/2)-1 even though the sphere dimension is identical. The exact all-n quotient-rank formula gives usable equivariant topology, including rank 13 for n=8 against rank 253 before quotienting. These are systematic natural invariants for an infinite family rather than an arbitrary finite table or textbook numerical substitution.
